print('Verified one six-verse stanza in both editions.')

item.text:
Reconstructed all six Urdu verses of *La Ilaha Illallah* and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions contain one six-verse stanza. Updated the title and right-to-left direction and cleared the `noUrdu` tag.

Read “Barhim” as `براہیم` and omitted the trailing “Tazmeen:” heading because no verses followed it.
